measurement_scope: Desktop headless preparation component, one fresh/new-process pair per fixture/direction; OS cache not cleared, other root native work may overlap exact-engine repeat. No Android, cold-storage, total-loading or graphics performance claim.
trust_boundary: Checksum detects corruption and structural validator bounds decoding; deliberately rewritten and rechecksummed valid numeric layouts are not authenticated. Only client workers read them. Server/canonical verification uses disk-free fresh construction and remains authoritative.
limits: No device query or test, APK/export, owner-save/process change, network/backend request or deployment.

First-ever/new/mutated tracks still use unchanged builder; first-use graphics linking remains separate.
Source guard changed only to include engine commit hash after retained layout/replay/coverage tests; final write/restart/contracts rerun with regenerated exact-engine identity.
Only offline certificate-store diagnostics remain in final headless logs.
